{{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}}

::: {#exr-child-break-jacket}
Human staffing for a project or enterprise has dimension C (that is, [capita]). Human effort expended in completing a project has dimension C T, reflecting that a person needs time to accomplish anything.

What is the relationship between staffing and human effort?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_cbj.1.uwd
- 'Staffing is proportional to effort expended.':
    correct: false
    feedback: 'Sorry. Staffing and effort have different dimensions.'
- 'Staffing is the derivative of effort with respect to time.':
    correct: true
- 'Staffing is the accumulation of effort with respect to time.':
    correct: false
    feedback: 'No. Since effort has dimension CT, the accumulation of effort with respect to time would have dimension C T^2^.'
- 'Staffing and effort have unrelated dimensions.':
    correct: false
```
